Your local guide

A Bluffton native who knows the Lowcountry inside and out.

As a native of Bluffton, South Carolina, Mackenzie is deeply rooted in the charm and culture of the Lowcountry. With a degree in Biology, she has a genuine appreciation for the natural beauty and unique ecosystems that make this area special — whether it's shrimping along serene waterways or enjoying vibrant evenings in downtown Bluffton.

Her love for the Lowcountry drives her dedication to helping clients find their perfect home or investment property — not just a house, but a place that feels like home. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, searching for a vacation retreat, or ready to sell, Mackenzie is here to guide you through every step.
